title: Query length bounded by data length
statement: Let $d$ and $q$ be binary strings. If the pair encoding $\langle d,q\rangle$ is a yes-instance of the Boolean circuit value language—that is, it encodes a fan-in-two circuit and an input on which that circuit evaluates to true—then $|q|\le |d|$.
hypotheses_covered: $\langle d,q\rangle$ belongs to the query language, meaning its pair encoding is in the Boolean circuit value language
